claims.text: The baseline systems were built using KyTea-segmented Japanese texts and pyvi-segmented Vietnamese texts, with one system using traditional phrase-based SMT and the other using NMT.
The aim of the NMT systems was to serve as a reproducible baseline for further research in low-resourced language pairs like Japanese and Vietnamese.
